prompt:
USE CASE: stylized-concept. Create one finished opaque background illustration for a Warwrit visual-novel scene.

SUBJECT: The old abandoned watermill: rough grey stone walls, a partly collapsed shingle roof with exposed broken rafters, and a broken wooden waterwheel on the stream side. Its condition is visibly ruined and non-operational. A closed timber cellar hatch belongs to the adjacent muddy yard. No newly repaired roof, functioning wheel, mill workers or invented supernatural event.

COMPOSITION: A wide three-quarter establishing view into the mill yard, with the wheel and stream on the left and the closed cellar hatch clearly readable in the central middle ground. The ruined mill is the main shape. Lead the eye from the yard approach to the hatch and building. Keep a quiet lower band for later dialogue placement; draw no interface. Full-bleed landscape, requested canvas 1536x1024.

ART DIRECTION: Restrained graphic novel; serious grounded dark fantasy. Draw with confident irregular ink contours on major forms, broad matte flat washes and coherent shadow masses. Suggest wear through a few purposeful marks. Keep most stone, wood, foliage and ground surfaces quiet. Use desaturated slate, soot, umber, muted ochre and restrained moss olive. This must read as authored ink-and-wash illustration, with deliberate shape design rather than photographic surface detail.

VISUAL HIERARCHY: Establish three broad depth/value groups before drawing small details. Keep the mill, wheel and hatch distinct at thumbnail size. Place the sharpest useful edges around those structures; simplify foreground mud, vegetation and distant trees into broad masses. Do not outline every stone, shingle, leaf or reed. Dark atmosphere must retain readable forms.

LIGHT: Soft overcast daylight from upper left. A broad readable midtone reveals the focal wall, wheel and hatch, while recesses form connected shadows. Keep sky, stream and foreground below the subject in local contrast. Avoid blacked-out buildings, bright sunset stripes and sparkling water.

REFERENCE RULE: If approved Warwrit reference images are supplied, use them for rendering language, palette and material character. The subject brief controls identity and condition. Do not reproduce an unrelated reference's layout, additional objects or fine surface noise.

EXCLUSIONS: No text, labels, runes, emblems, watermark, border, collage, UI, decorative fantasy castle, cute rounded architecture, pristine masonry, saturated orange foliage, glossy CGI, photographic texture, all-over grain, dense crosshatching or repeated tiny highlights. Do not add people, creatures, props or story facts not requested.

DELIVERY: One coherent opaque image, not isolated cutout art or a contact sheet. Prioritize clear composition and credible weathered construction over decorative detail.
